title: 第16章 野兽第15章 召集之路
content_zh:
“既然你开口了，这两位肯定有特殊的本事咯……”
萨丽的目光在两人身上转了一圈，最后落在老乞丐身上，脸上带着一抹尊重。
“呵呵！”老乞丐邋遢的抠了抠鼻子，随即面带笑意的看着面前的女人，心中已经猜到了两人的身份。
“我们只是情报贩子而已，当然比不上南部公爵之女，萨丽小姐！”
随后，他又看向女人身旁的长弓护卫，神色陡然郑重了几分：“……还有这位传奇猎魔人，萨尔诺阁下！”
萨丽眼中闪过几分诧异之色，她从来没有踏足过北境帝国，同时一些情报贩子也很难绕过萨尔诺接近自己。
可没想到这邋遢的老乞丐，居然一眼就看出来了。
老乞丐脸上闪过一抹傲然之色，他看向萨尔诺手中的赤红大弓，眼里忽然有了一丝追忆之色：“能让传说中的守望者当护卫，那你的身份就很好猜了！”
萨尔诺眼眸微微眯起，他总感觉面前这老家伙有点熟悉，随即敲了敲手中的大弓：“你认识这把武器？”
老乞丐神色复杂地点了点头，脸色罕见的郑重起来：“洛瑞安流星弓……我曾和那个老家伙并肩作战！”
话音落下，三人都是满脸诧异的看着他，就连凯撒也有些好奇的盯着老乞丐，没想到这家伙还有这么一层身份。
“都看着我这把老骨头干什么？曾经的事情懒得再提了！”
老乞丐无奈地摆了摆手，再次变成了那副邋遢的模样，但眼里的浑浊却在这一刻散去了几分。
然而他似乎又想到了什么，突然靠近抚摸着萨尔诺的皮肤，在其手臂的血管上按了几下：“洛瑞安这个老东西啊……”
萨尔诺站在原地没有躲开，他总觉得这老家伙格外熟悉，自己父亲似乎曾经提起过。
而老乞丐则从怀中拿出一枚散发着幽幽蓝光的宝珠，犹豫了片刻，最终还是扔给了这个后辈。
“只要把这个东西吃了，秘法时间就可以延长很久！”
萨尔诺看着手中的幽蓝宝珠，脸上的神色骤然变得震惊起来，他终于想到曾经在哪见过这老乞丐了。
那个时候，父亲还没有在外海失踪，但当年有一位挚友却将传承留给了他，这一幕恰好被自己撞见。
而那位神秘猎魔人给予的传承，就是强化血管的制作秘法，可以短暂地移植各种生命的血脉。

这种秘法强大到足以改变一个猎魔人的上限，但代价也同样的残酷，每次使用都是在拿自己的血管当柴烧。
萨尔诺死死看着手中的宝珠，如果这老乞丐说的是真的，那自己的实力将会得到极大的增强，特别是战斗的时间。
他这些年来最头疼的问题，不是打不过对手，而是还没打完自己就先撑不住了。
他数年前曾被皇室的禁军统领雷格纳打败，但其实在刚刚交手的阶段，自己并没有落入下风，甚至前半程根本分不出胜负。
而最终之所以会落败，纯粹是因为海龙血管对身体的负荷很严重，所以自己的战斗时间有限。
如果这枚宝珠真的可以解除限制，那就意味着他可以长时间战斗，再次对上雷格纳至少不会输的那么狼狈。
而萨丽看着萨尔诺罕见的兴奋模样，也很快察觉出其中的关系。
她脸上顿时露出一抹温和的笑容，看向老乞丐的目光也变得格外郑重：“老前辈，我的黑曜石商会正好需要情报网，到时候就交给您了……”
然而似乎是害怕老乞丐不同意，她陡然朝着身旁的凯撒靠了过去：“这位看起来可不一般，到时候你想知道什么秘密，我都会告诉你。”
老乞丐和身旁的卡莎对视了一眼，最终考虑到北境目前混乱的局势，他还是答应了招揽：“好吧，好吧。”
只不过，他之所以答应女人的招揽，更多还是因为凯撒。
毕竟，灰烬可从来没有女公爵的先例，可凯撒刚刚的称呼就意味着，他会站在这位公爵之女的背后。
content_en:
"Now that you've spoken, these two must have special abilities..."
Sally's eyes moved around the two people, and finally landed on the old beggar, with a look of respect on her face.
"Haha!" The old beggar picked his nose sloppily, and then looked at the woman in front of him with a smile, already guessing their identities.
"We are just information dealers. Of course we are not as good as Miss Sally, the daughter of the Duke of the South!"
Then, he looked at the longbow guard beside the woman, and his expression suddenly became more solemn: "...and this legendary demon hunter, Mr. Sarno!"
There was a bit of surprise in Sally's eyes. She had never set foot in the Northern Empire. At the same time, it was difficult for some intelligence dealers to bypass Sarno and get close to her.
But I didn’t expect that this sloppy old beggar could be recognized at a glance.
A look of pride flashed across the old beggar's face. He looked at the red bow in Sarno's hand, and suddenly there was a trace of reminiscence in his eyes: "If you can have the legendary watcher as a guard, then your identity will be easy to guess!"
Sarno's eyes narrowed slightly. He always felt that the old guy in front of him seemed familiar, and then he knocked on the big bow in his hand: "Do you know this weapon?"
The old beggar nodded with a complicated expression, and his face became rarely solemn: "Lorian Meteor Bow... I once fought side by side with that old guy!"
After the words fell, the three of them looked at him in surprise. Even Caesar stared at the old beggar with some curiosity. He didn't expect that this guy had such an identity.
"Why are you looking at my old bones? I'm too lazy to mention what happened in the past!"
The old beggar waved his hand helplessly and turned into his sloppy look again, but the turbidity in his eyes dissipated a bit at this moment.
However, he seemed to have thought of something again. He suddenly approached and touched Sarno's skin, and pressed a few times on the blood vessels of his arm: "This old thing Lorien..."
Sarno stood there without moving away. He always felt that this old guy was particularly familiar. His father seemed to have mentioned it before.
The old beggar took out an orb that exuded a faint blue light from his arms, hesitated for a moment, and finally threw it to the junior.
"As long as you eat this thing, the secret time can be extended for a long time!"
Sarno looked at the blue orb in his hand, and the expression on his face suddenly became shocked. He finally remembered where he had seen this old beggar before.
At that time, his father had not yet disappeared overseas, but a close friend had left the inheritance to him, and he happened to see this scene.
The inheritance given by the mysterious demon hunter is the secret method of making blood vessels that can be temporarily transplanted with the blood of all kinds of life.
This secret method is powerful enough to change the upper limit of a demon hunter, but the price is equally cruel. Every time it is used, one's own blood vessels are used as firewood.
Sarno stared at the orb in his hand. If what this old beggar said was true, his strength would be greatly enhanced, especially during the battle.
His biggest headache over the years was not that he couldn't beat his opponent, but that he couldn't hold on before he finished beating himself.
A few years ago, he was defeated by Regnar, the commander of the royal family's imperial army. However, in the initial stage of the fight, he was not at a disadvantage. In the first half, there was no way to tell the winner.
The reason why he lost in the end was purely because Hailong's blood vessels put a heavy load on his body, so his fighting time was limited.
If this orb can really lift the restriction, it means that he can fight for a long time, and at least he won't lose so embarrassingly against Regna again.
Seeing Sarno's rare excitement, Sally quickly noticed the connection.
A gentle smile suddenly appeared on her face, and her look at the old beggar became particularly solemn: "Old senior, my Obsidian Chamber of Commerce needs an intelligence network, and I will leave it to you then..."
HoweverAs if she was afraid that the old beggar would disagree, she suddenly leaned towards Caesar beside her: "This one looks extraordinary. I will tell you any secrets you want to know when the time comes."
The old beggar looked at Kasha next to him. Finally, considering the current chaotic situation in the north, he agreed to the solicitation: "Okay, okay."
However, the reason why he agreed to the woman's solicitation was mostly because of Caesar.
After all, there has never been a precedent for a duchess in Ashes, but what Caesar just called her meant that he would stand behind the daughter of a duke.
